schoolName: Adventist University of Central Africa — Adventist School of Medicine of East Central Africa
reviewNotes: HOLD — AUCA is listed by Rwanda HEC as an operating private higher-learning institution. The university’s official site exposes current general undergraduate requirements, including a USD 50 international application fee, NESA equivalence and study-visa information. A current Adventist Accrediting Association directory records the Adventist School of Medicine of East Central Africa at AUCA and describes a three-year Medicine plus three-year Surgery structure, but AUCA’s current public programme catalogue does not publish the medical programme’s fee schedule, admissions requirements, intake, teaching language, clinical placements or a dedicated international application route. The regulator document found establishes AUCA’s institutional presence, not a current programme-specific medical approval. Do not package or publish until those gaps are resolved directly from AUCA/HEC/RMDC sources.
